_about: Watch-storage pilot (wristhomage#26, moondog-portfolio#49). Every figure comes from the maker's own publication: the maker's website, or the maker's own Amazon listing when the maker sells there and has no site. 'maker fit' is a figure about the inside (a slot width, a clearance height, a pillow circumference and the wrist range the maker gives for it). 'maker claim' is a size limit stated as a case diameter only, which ignores lugs, crown, thickness and bracelet closure, so the pages never treat it as proof of fit. No prices (moondog-portfolio#134). Seller rule (beautyevidence#28 precedent, affiliate architect decision on wristhomage#26, 2026-09-27): a row is linked only while its buy box is sold by Amazon.com or by the brand's own store named in scripts/storage.py BRAND_STORES; anything else carries no link and says why.
